about: T23.02, re-derived by T23.03B under R19, split by back end under R25 (T23.08C): look-compare thresholds, each a maximum distance. Measured, not picked: in each set, threshold = midpoint of that set's floor and the SMALLEST control of the must-fail set (mustFail: F0 vs F1, exposure +/-10 %, bloom off, fog off). rim-off and F2 are sensitivity lines: their failures are listed under each set's `sensitivity`, they do not place a threshold. `deferred` metrics are computed and gate nothing (R25: deltaE_actors, created by T23.12 on cast frames). A check picks its set from the renderer string (look-compare.mjs::thresholdsFor; an unknown renderer throws). `node scripts/lib/look-compare.mjs --derive` rewrites every set's floor/metrics/dropped/sensitivity/box (look-compare.mjs::deriveThresholds, ::labFloor); scripts/lib/look-compare.test.mjs re-derives them from the PNGs and fails if the file differs.

floor: The mockup's floor is 0: F1 re-rendered by the mockup is byte-identical to reference/F1-night-combat.png (cmp). R25 (T23.08C): each set carries its own floor from the LOOK-LAB's F1 world frame (?look=F1&only=world, full tier, 1280x720 MSAA 4). `swiftshader` = two renders on the checks' back end (headless chromium, separate launches; byte-identical, so the floor is 0 on every metric and the thresholds are R19's rule from zero). `gpu` = the spread between back ends: SwiftShader against the owner's GPU (google-chrome headed, GALLIUM_DRIVER=d3d12, D3D12 Intel Arc B390 — the only GPU on this box; D3D12 twice is byte-identical too, T23.08 and T23.08C renders cmp equal). The spread is the sky's hash grain and its star grid (±1-2 levels, some stars on one GPU and not the other), not the terrain. A floor measured across two GPUs must not loosen checks that only run on one (R25).

bloomBox.about: T23.08: the moon's bloom — mean |delta| per channel over the box. In a frame with no cast the moon is the only thing above P.bloom's threshold, and the whole-frame metrics cannot see its halo: the mockup's own bloom-off passes every one of them against F1-world (look-gate-f1). Box = where F1-world and its bloom-off differ, grown to the disc and halo.

bloomHalo.about: T23.08C (R25): the moon's halo as a ring, the disc excluded. Centre = the centroid of F1-world-bloom-off's px brighter than luma 150 near the moon (1021.4, 96.0; 44 px, equivalent radius 3.7). Radii measured from the radial profile of |F1-world - F1-world-bloom-radius-0| against the SwiftShader/D3D12 spread, 4-px rings: radius 0 moves 5.38 / 2.64 / 1.12 / 0.64 / 0.29 over r 4-8 / 8-12 / 12-16 / 16-20 / 20-24 where the spread is 0.46 / 0.31 / 0.40 / 0.52 / 0.47. Inner 4 = the disc's radius; outer 16 = the last ring where radius 0 moves the halo more than twice the spread. bloomBox's 110x100 px is mostly far sky where radius 0 moves 0.03 and the spread 0.4, which is why it could not see the radius (T23.08's known limit).

deferred.deltaE_actors: R25: placed on cast frames by the actor set (T23.12: F4, the cast sheet — look-thresholds.json `actors`), not by F1's rows

actors.about: R25 (T23.12): the actor-box threshold, deltaE_actors = mean CIEDE2000 over the union of a scene's actor boxes (look-compare.mjs::boxesDeltaE). Placed on F4, the cast sheet, where the cast is the subject: reference = the mockup's F4 with only what the look-lab does not draw taken out (controls/castonly.js: the fx group and the text), controls = the same with one knob turned. Must-fail = R19's through the mockup plus rim-off (ACTOR_MUST_FAIL; R19's F0 has no F4 counterpart). Each set's floor = two look-lab renders of F4 (sets.<name>.actors.frames); threshold = midpoint of that floor and the smallest control, by R19's rule. The lab renders are made in the reference harness's browser (render.mjs: --use-gl=angle --use-angle=swiftshader), where Chrome rasterises a 2D canvas on the GPU as the mockup's was: under the checks' --use-gl=swiftshader every canvas is rasterised on the CPU, which dithers gradients (measured, F4 actor boxes: 0.50 against 0.12). T23.13 (coordinator, 2026-09-27: like-for-like per back end): the gpu set names its own reference and controls — the mockup rendered on D3D12 with the lab's own curve flattening applied to its canvas (controls/flatpatch.js: the D3D12 canvas draws roundRect/half-ellipses/stroked arcs wrong, T23.12) — and its floor is two D3D12 lab renders. The cross-back-end spread (SwiftShader lab vs D3D12 lab, rim on: 0.49) no longer places a threshold. Floor frames are T23.13's (rim passes on).
